parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: A translation by $\begin{pmatrix}0\\2\end{pmatrix}$ and a stretch of scale factor $\frac13$ parallel to the $x$-axis.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Translation $\begin{pmatrix}0\\2\end{pmatrix}$, or translation 2 parallel to the $y$-axis/in the $y$-direction/vertically — B1. Condone “shift” and a vector written as coordinates. Allow any mention of the $y$-axis but not just “up”. Stretch, scale factor $\frac13$, parallel to the $x$-axis/in the $x$-direction/horizontally — B2,1,0; B2 for all three components, B1 for two. Allow “the $y$-axis is invariant”. Total 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $y=3g(-x)$ — B2,1,0. B1 for 3 outside the function and nowhere else, or a minus sign inside the function and nowhere else. Thus $-3g(x)$, $3(-g(x))$, $g(-3x)$, $g(-x/3)$, $3g(x)+2$, $-3g(-x)$ and $3g(-x^3)$ each score B1. $3g(3x)$ and $-g(-x)$ score B0. SC B1 for $3f(-x)$. Total 2.
